changes.comment: `InstrumentedEvent` now carries `reason` and `vetoedBy`, the two fields `EmitResult` gained in 0.8.0. That release gave attribution to the emitter and not to the observer, so an instrumentation consumer could report `committed: false` and could not say whether a guard had refused the action, a double-click had been deduplicated, or a cascade had breached its ceiling — three things wanting three different responses, which is the argument 0.8.0 itself made for `EmitResult`. Instrumentation is the only seam that sees uncommitted events without the observer joining the pipeline, so there was nowhere else to gather it; the values were already computed and dropped. Documented with its honest limit: a deduplicated event never reaches instrumentation and neither does a cascade refusal, so `reason` reads `"vetoed"` or nothing today.
